method: Ten quoted sentence searches, two samples per article. Compare returned search text to normalized sample sentences and their 12-word phrases. Search engines may relax quotation marks; this is not a full-text plagiarism service or a guarantee covering all indexed/unindexed content.

evidence.query: "The wide straw has a job: it brings a little chew into an otherwise smooth sip."
"Taro is one of the smoothie flavors listed on our menu, alongside strawberry, peach, mango, banana, and avocado."
"The first spoonful of a three-bean dessert rarely looks like the second."
"Try a little from the top before reaching farther into the cup."
"Lemongrass gives a beef vermicelli bowl a fragrant lift before the noodles even reach your fork."
"The bún section of our menu uses rice vermicelli as a base for several dishes."
"A grilled pork chop, a fried egg and steamed rice give this plate three distinct jobs."
"An egg gives the rice another savory partner alongside the pork."
"Steamed rice is the quiet half of a plate built around glossy, sauce-coated chicken."
"The appeal is in the meeting of the chicken’s exterior and its sauce."
